title: Protocol for DNA extraction from clay-rich subsoils
author: Lukas Beule
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhmjj44n

steps.title: Prepare soil sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 200 ± 5 mg of freeze-dried soil into a 2-mL tube.

steps.title: Homogenize sample
steps.instruction: Perform bead beating to homogenize the sample.

substeps.instruction: Use 3 tungsten carbide beads (ø 3 mm)
Bead beat for 1 min at 25 Hz using a swing mill (e.g. MM 400, Retsch, Germany)

steps.title: Lysis and incubation
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using PB buffer (1 M Na2HPO4 and 1 M NaH2PO4, pH 7.2) with 0.5% SDS (w/v).

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL PB buffer with 0.5% SDS (w/v) and vortex for 10 sec at max speed
Incubate the suspension at 65°C for 10 min
Shake the samples every 60 sec for 5 sec

steps.title: Initial supernatant recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant from the soil lysate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 min at 10,000 rpm
Transfer 90 µL of the supernatant into a new 2-mL tube

steps.title: Phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Perform phenol extraction using redistilled phenol equilibrated in TE buffer (pH 7.5 to 8.0).

substeps.instruction: Add 810 µL ddH2O (1:10 dilution)
Add 900 µL phenol and shake the samples briefly
Centrifuge for 10 min at 10,000 rpm
Transfer 800 µL of the upper phase into a new 2-mL tube

steps.title: First chloroform:isoamylalcohol wash
steps.instruction: Wash the aqueous phase with chloroform:isoamylalcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µL chloroform:isoamylalcohol (24:1 (v/v))
Incubate 10 min on ice
Centrifuge for 10 min at 10,000 rpm
Transfer 700 µL of the upper phase into a new 1.5 mL-tube

steps.title: Second chloroform:isoamylalcohol wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash with chloroform:isoamylalcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL chloroform:isoamylalcohol (24:1)
Incubate 10 min on ice
Centrifuge for 10 min at 10,000 rpm
Transfer 600 µL of the upper phase into a new 1.5 mL-tube

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using PEG and NaCl.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the 1.5 mL-tube contains 200 µL 30% PEG 6000 and 100 µL 5M NaCl
Shake the mixture and incubate at room temperature for 20 min
Centrifuge for 15 min at max speed

steps.title: Pellet washing
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 500 µL 80% EtOH (v/v) twice
Centrifuge for 5 min at max speed between each wash
Remove supernatant by pipetting
Use vacuum centrifugation at 30°C for 20 minutes (or until dry) under a sterile bench
Add 50 µL TE buffer
Vortex or flick the samples to release the pellet from the tube wall
Incubate at 42°C for 2h (e.g. in a water bath)
